title: Distinguish unmeasured StateMutex counters from zero waits in fixture phase reports
outcome: Fixture phase diagnostics explicitly identify whether they installed StateMutex instrumentation and describe release-phase attribution for both main and background whole holds.
acceptance: A phase report from a test with no timed StateMutex identifies lock timing as unavailable rather than implying zero contention; instrumented reports distinguish measured counters, and wording explains that whole holds are assigned at release. Existing separate parallel-model lock reports and behavior remain unchanged.
